status: research and reuse plan, not Lean completion
priority_rule: Select a dependency-ready theorem delta with the largest audited downstream reuse per realistic proof cost; do not force one universal abstraction.

stages.title: Fix statements and oracle contracts
stages.target: Pin measures, spaces, constants, metrics, input access, randomness, output error and source editions before comparing routes.
stages.search: Samplinglib Registry; active Frontier Cells; source maps

stages.title: Convexity, duality and quadratic energies
stages.target: One convex/subgradient/conjugacy core; typed adapters for extended values, Euclidean and measure-valued energies.
stages.search: TechnicalLemmas/Analysis/ConvexSubgradient.lean; Geometry/StrongConvexity.lean; Mathlib convex APIs; Optlib; CvxLean

stages.title: Measures, couplings and probability kernels
stages.target: Pushforwards, couplings, marginal transfer and finite moments; distinguish deterministic maps from stochastic kernels.

stages.title: Differentiation, Taylor remainder and geometry
stages.target: Reusable normed-space Taylor bounds, chain rules and gradients; manifold adapters separately account for retractions and curvature.

stages.title: Transport existence, duality and displacement
stages.target: OT Chapter 1 with Appendix A/B as needed; no duplicate coupling or convex-potential infrastructure.

stages.title: Gibbs variational principle, KL and dissipation
stages.target: Common entropy/convex core supports OT Chapter 4 and proximal/MFLD routes; sampler invariance remains separate.
stages.search: TechnicalLemmas/InformationTheory; existing Fisher/entropy APIs; primary proofs

stages.title: Geometry-to-flow interfaces
stages.target: OT Chapters 5–6, Boumal and sampling share tested tangent/weak-continuity/energy-dissipation interfaces where types really agree.
stages.search: Existing weak FP and FisherTransport APIs; AGS metric gradient-flow contracts

stages.title: Statistical estimation and metric geometry
stages.target: Parallel branches: OT Chapters 2–3 + empirical-process leaves; Chapters 7→8 + metric curvature/barycenters. Entropic rates additionally consume entropy.
stages.search: Mathlib probability and concentration; source Chapter 2–4 assumptions; statistical rather than computational n

stages.title: Higher-smoothness upper bounds
stages.target: Fix one potential class and oracle, prove local remainder/moment bounds and invariant target, then combine with existing mixing or contraction. Do not wait for all OT flow theory.
stages.search: Nesterov high-order Taylor models; Mou et al.; Shen–Lee; pinned sampling contraction leaves

stages.title: Sampling oracle lower bounds
stages.target: Separate hard-instance and information-transcript lane. Additional convexity or statistical-testing ingredients are task-specific, not every upper-bound lemma.
stages.search: SampleWiki exact lower-bound papers; oracle transcript kernels; testing/data-processing APIs

stages.title: Compare matched upper and lower contracts
stages.target: Only compare identical potential classes, derivative access, error metrics, starts and cost conventions. A cross-domain lower bound requires an explicit reduction.
stages.search: Common contract schema; no theorem equivalence inferred from a shared label
